name: Descript
freeTierNote: Free tier with limited media hours and starter credits — check official limits.
priceBand: Free tier; Hobbyist — check official pricing
bestFor: Editing podcasts and talking-head video as if they were a doc
keyFeatures: Edit audio and video by deleting transcript text
Studio Sound cleanup for basic mics
limitations: Not a generative cinematic video tool
Proper nouns still need manual transcript review
summary: Transcript-first editing. The AI is in service of cutting ums, not inventing a movie.
body: Descript is the tool we recommend to people who record interviews, not to people who want a spaceship trailer. Overdub and filler-word removal are the jobs. Compare it with ElevenLabs only if your bottleneck is voice generation, not editing. Plans checked 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Transcription accuracy still needs a human pass for names
Good companion to a cheap USB mic
